## Defined types

### <a name="recursive_file_permissions"></a>`recursive_file_permissions`

recursive_file_permissions

A defined type for changing file and directory permissions recursively.

#### Examples

#####

```puppet
recursive_file_permissions { '/my_dir':
  file_mode => '0644',
  dir_mode  => '0744',
  owner     => 'me',
  group     => 'us',
 }
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `recursive_file_permissions` defined type:

* [`target_dir`](#-recursive_file_permissions--target_dir)
* [`file_mode`](#-recursive_file_permissions--file_mode)
* [`dir_mode`](#-recursive_file_permissions--dir_mode)
* [`owner`](#-recursive_file_permissions--owner)
* [`group`](#-recursive_file_permissions--group)

##### <a name="-recursive_file_permissions--target_dir"></a>`target_dir`

Data type: `Recursive_file_permissions::Unixpath`

Directory to manage recursively.

Default value: `$title`

##### <a name="-recursive_file_permissions--file_mode"></a>`file_mode`

Data type: `Optional[Recursive_file_permissions::Filemode]`

Mode for all files below `target_dir`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-recursive_file_permissions--dir_mode"></a>`dir_mode`

Data type: `Optional[Recursive_file_permissions::Filemode]`

Mode for all directories below `target_dir`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-recursive_file_permissions--owner"></a>`owner`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Owner for all files and directories below `target_dir`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-recursive_file_permissions--group"></a>`group`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Group for all files and directories below `target_dir`.

Default value: `undef`
